test_objective: Check that you can append a JsonProperty property to an entity

test_cases.name: 010_10_01 Append a JSON property
test_cases.doc: Check that you can append a JsonProperty property to an entity
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Append Entity Attributes with Response Status Code set to 204     and
        Retrieve Entity by Id with Check Updated Entity and
            Query Parameter: 'updated_resource' set to 'entity_expectation_payload' and
            Query Parameter: 'response_body' set to 'response1.json()' and
            Query Parameter: 'ignored_keys' set to '${None}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}/attrs'
        method set to 'POST'
        Append Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'vehicle-new-json-property-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
